protocol.order: same process, alternate before/after and after/before each pair
protocol.timed: NativeRenderer render + submission.wait; retained cases include transaction commit. SVG vector cases alternate two pre-lowered Canvas resources every frame, forcing image cache invalidation. SVG parsing/lowering, compilation and readback excluded.
protocol.pixels: Exact initial/final baseline/cleanup readback equality per case. SVG vector cases also compare the second color variant before warmup.

scene.path_case: same geometry as 128 rectangles, submitted as vector paths to a cropped isolated blur

retained.sparse_translation: one node per frame, translated 1/2 px alternately per 256-frame cycle
retained.dense_translation: all nodes translated 0/1 px every frame
retained.group_opacity: eight opacity groups, each with 32 leaves; one group changes 0.5/0.8 per frame

svg_vectors.variants: two pre-lowered resources with identical geometry and different background colors, swapped each frame
svg_vectors.repeated_images: eight 2050x256 SVG image nodes, four rows with two overlapping images each at 0.5 opacity
svg_vectors.nested_images: two nested SVG image levels at 2050x256
svg_vectors.mixed_placements: large 2050x256 pattern and a 64x64 atlas pattern over half the parent
svg_vectors.API: usvg::Tree::from_str -> Canvas::push_svg -> NativeRenderer::render; each binary side uses its own matching usvg dependency
